project: Infographic-Style Terms of Use Landing Page
design_philosophy: Legal document turned into Art. A premium, minimal, editorial presentation using high-contrast typography, structural grid lines, and infographic visual storytelling.

rules: Use #F9F9FA as the main canvas background to soften the contrast slightly.
Use #FFFFFF for cards, infographic containers, and bento boxes.
Use #000000 for all primary typography to maintain an authoritative editorial feel.
Use #e57119 (Orange) strictly for accents, key data points, hover states, and the primary CTA.
Swiss Brutalist Approach: Maximize the contrast within the Lato family. Use Lato Black (900) for massive section numbers and H1, paired with Lato Light (300) for body copy.
Never center align body paragraphs. Left align for readability.
Use uppercase with wide letter-spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and labels.

layout_and_grids.spacing: Extremely generous padding (py-24, py-32) between major sections.
layout_and_grids.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid #E5E5E5 borders to separate rows and infographic bento items to create a technical, structured aesthetic.

visual_enhancers.imagery: STRICTLY NO HUMANS OR PHOTOS. Use only abstract, geometric, or isometric line-art SVG illustrations.
visual_enhancers.icons: Minimalist stroke-based icons (1.5px to 2px stroke width) in #000000 or #e57119.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat colors only. NO glassmorphism. NO drop shadows. Rely entirely on 1px crisp borders to define surfaces (Brutalist Infographic style).

libraries: Lenis (via CDN for momentum smooth scroll)
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Wrap each line of the H1 in a CSS container with `overflow: hidden`. Use GSAP to animate the `y` property of the inner text from 100% to 0% with `power4.out` easing.
motion.marquee: A slow, elegant CSS or GSAP based marquee. Text: 'WEB DESIGN — CUSTOM SOLUTIONS — DIGITAL MARKETING'. Continuous seamless loop.
motion.scroll_animations: Infographic elements (progress bars, pie charts, timelines) MUST animate their values (width/height/dashoffset) from 0 to actual value when ScrollTrigger detects they enter the viewport.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on background SVG line-art elements. Move them on the Y axis slightly slower than the scroll speed.

sections.name: Hero
sections.design: Minimalist. Massive 'TERMS OF USE' kinetic text. An abstract geometric SVG line-art illustration (representing 'digital solutions' or 'networks') placed asymmetrically in the background with a slow, continuous rotation.
sections.motion: Signature on-load moment: Masked line-by-line reveal of the title, followed by a fade-in of the geometric background.

sections.name: Editorial Marquee
sections.design: Full viewport width. 1px solid border on top and bottom. Background: #000000, Text: #e57119.

sections.name: Terms Manifesto (The Core)
sections.design: Restructured into Scannable Numbered Chapters. A 12-column CSS Grid layout.
structure: Left Column (col-span-3): Massive sticky numbers (e.g., '01', '02') in Lato Black.
Visuals: Replace standard legal paragraphs with stats, timelines, and line-art SVG icons.
Interactive: Provide a brief visual summary of the term, followed by an elegant '+' toggle (accordion) to reveal the dense legal text.

sections.name: CTA Section
sections.design: High impact. Solid #e57119 background. Massive #000000 typography. A sharp, pill-shaped or brutalist rectangular button with an arrow icon that translates right on hover.
sections.motion: The entire CTA background container scales up slightly (scale: 0.95 to 1) via ScrollTrigger as it enters the viewport.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure #e57119 text is readable against white/black backgrounds (adjust font-weight to bold if necessary to pass WCAG AA).
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='accordion-term-1'`, `data-testid='cta-button'`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You are building a premium, award-winning HTML/CSS/JS single-page site in `/app/landing/`.
DO NOT USE REACT. DO NOT USE SHADCN. Everything must be Vanilla HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JS.
You may use Tailwind CSS via CDN for rapid utility classes, OR write pure CSS. Ensure layout matches the strict grid rules.
Include CDN links for Lenis, GSAP, and ScrollTrigger in the HTML `<head>`.
Initialize Lenis in your JS file immediately to ensure the entire page has a premium, weighted smooth scroll.
Embed inline SVGs for all illustrations. DO NOT use placeholder image URLs. Draw geometric nodes, lines, and abstract shapes using `<svg>` paths.
Never use human imagery or photos.
Ensure the header navigation does not have a completely transparent background if content scrolls under it (use solid white or black).
Maintain extreme optical alignment. Spacing should feel luxurious and deliberate.
